$note: Values the old catalogues got wrong in a way parity checking cannot see: the key exists in all three languages, so nothing failed, but the Spanish entry held English text (or, for one Brazilian e-invoicing message, Portuguese). A missing key is loud; a key whose value is in the wrong language is silent, which is why these survived. Each entry replaces all three languages so the triple is consistent.
